apps.title: BashChat
apps.description: A real-time chat application with a modern WhatsApp-style interface, designed for seamless communication.
benefits: Secure communication with text, images, voice, and video
Data stored locally on client servers/machines for maximum privacy
Easy group collaboration with multimedia support
features: Send text, images, voice, and video messages
Local server storage for complete security
targets: Teams and organizations that value data sovereignty
Individuals who want a secure alternative to cloud-based messengers

apps.title: BashFlex
apps.description: A movie, series, and sports streaming application optimized for local and internet use.
benefits: Optimized file formats for fast playback
features: Works with MikroTik User Manager for local streaming
targets: Individuals wanting a Netflix-style experience offline

apps.title: BashKart
apps.description: A commercial e-commerce app similar to Amazon, enabling secure online shopping.
features: Responsive design for mobile and desktop

apps.title: BashMotors
